# HV Verse

> HV Verse is a set of three free, AI-powered web apps for personal and career growth, made by Harsh Goyal (India) and launched on 1 October 2026. The apps run in any browser on phone or laptop, with nothing to install. HV AI, the built-in assistant, understands English, Hindi and Hinglish, typed or spoken, and always asks before it changes anything.

- Website: https://thehvverse.com/
- Price: free for everyone, HV AI included
- Made by: Harsh Goyal (https://www.linkedin.com/in/harshvittori)
- Company: Haritt Group (https://haritt.com/), spelled with two Ts. Sister brand: Haritt Developers (https://developers.haritt.com/), websites, software, branding and AI solutions for businesses

## The three apps

- [HV Assess](https://thehvverse.com/assess/): self-assessment tests. Start with the free Maturity Assessment (28 to 30 real-life situations): a score out of 100, a level, a checkable scorecard with a unique ID, a full report PDF and a 30-day plan. No login. Open the app: https://thehvverse.com/hv-assess/
- [HV Reset](https://thehvverse.com/reset/): a daily planner that shows one task at a time, shifts the whole day when you run late, and gives you a personal dashboard for time, focus, streaks and progress. Open the app: https://thehvverse.com/hv-reset/
- [HV Hunt](https://thehvverse.com/hunt/): a job-search tracker for every job, company, recruiter, follow-up and interview, with a pipeline board, resume vault and analytics. Tell HV AI what happened and it updates the board. Google sign-in keeps your data private. Open the app: https://thehvverse.com/hv-hunt/

## Facts

- HV Assess results are for personal growth, not a clinical or psychological diagnosis.
- Who it's for: students, job seekers, working professionals, anyone who wants to know themselves better and stay consistent.
